sentences.en: One of the visitors cried out to obstruct the proceedings.
sentences.zh: 一位参观者喊叫着试图阻止正在进行的程序。

sentences.en: She was trying to inject some fun into the grim proceedings.
sentences.zh: 她正努力在严肃的活动中增添一些乐趣。

sentences.en: The committee will review the minutes from yesterday's proceedings.
sentences.zh: 委员会将审议昨天会议的纪要。
